en: The categorical syllogism has as its middle the universality existing in and for itself, or the nature of the individual subject, of which as such an essential property is asserted and which is joined together with this subject.
zh: 定言推论以自在自为的那个普遍者、亦即个别主体的本性为其中项；关于这个本性作为这样的本性，有某个本质的属性被述说，并与这个主体结合在一起。

en: The hypothetical syllogism expresses another determinate being as the ground of a determinate being.

If A is, then B is. Now A is. Therefore B is. — The determinations are no longer in the relation as the individual, the particular, and the universal; rather a determination, B, which is at first only one existing in itself or possible, is joined together with determinate being through A as middle, which is both determinate being and ground.
zh: 假言推论把另一个定在表述为一个定在的根据。
如果 A 是，那么 B 就是。现在 A 是。因此 B 就是。——这些规定不再是作为个别者、特殊者与普遍者处于这种关系之中；相反，一个规定 B——它起初只是一个自在的或可能的规定——通过作为中项的 A 与定在结合起来，而这个 A 既是定在又是根据。

en: In the disjunctive syllogism the ground of a determination's being joined to a subject consists in the fact that of the particular determinations of a universal sphere one part does not accrue to it, and thus the remaining part accrues to it, or conversely if the determination is separated from the subject. — A is either B or C or D. Now it is not B nor yet C. Therefore it is D.
zh: 在选言推论中，「一个规定与一个主体相结合」这一点的根据在于：一个一般领域的诸特殊规定中有一部分不归属于它，因而其余的部分归属于它；或者，当这个规定与主体被分开时，则反过来。——A 要么是 B，要么是 C，要么是 D。现在它既不是 B，也还不是 C。因此它是 D。

en: The middle is therefore the subject as a universal sphere in its complete particularity, and at the same time contains the excluding or positing of a part of these its determinations.
The subject, as a universal in itself, is the possibility of several determinations.
One passes over from its universality or possibility to its determinacy or actuality.
zh: 因此中项就是主体作为处在其完整特殊性中的一般领域，并且同时包含着对它这些规定中某一部分的排除或设定。
主体作为自在的普遍者，是若干规定的可能性。
于是就从它的普遍性或可能性过渡到它的规定性或现实性。

en: The survey of the form of the syllogisms shows that 1. in the qualitative syllogism the moments count in their qualitative difference.
They therefore require a mediating term which is their immediate unity but which falls outside them.
In the quantitative syllogisms the qualitative difference of the moments, and with it also the relation and the difference of the mediated and the immediate, is indifferent.
In the syllogisms of relation the mediation at the same time contains immediacy.
Thus from it there has emerged the concept of an immediacy of nature or of the qualitative difference, which is at once in and for itself mediation, purpose, and process.
zh: 对推论形式的概观表明：1. 在质的推论中，各环节是按其质的差别而论的。
因此它们需要一个中介者，这个中介者就是它们的直接统一，却又落在它们之外。
在量的推论中，各环节的质的差别，因而也是被中介者与直接者之间的关系和差别，都是无关紧要的。
在关系的推论中，中介同时包含着直接性。
因此从中得出一个概念：自然或质的差别的那种直接性，它同时自在自为地就是中介、目的和过程。

11.en: Second Part The Realization of the Concept
11.zh: 第二部分 概念的实现

en: In the judgment as in the syllogism the concept is [found] in immediate reality, the indifferent determinate being of subject and predicate, or the extremes of the syllogism go against one another and against the middle.
The objective is that these moments themselves in themselves become the whole, that their immediacy is thus precisely this, to be the whole.
zh: 在判断中如同在推论中一样，概念[在于]直接实在性，即主体与谓词的无关紧要的定在；或者说，推论的极端彼此相对并且反对中项。
客观性在于：这些环节自在地本身成为整体；它们的直接性因此恰恰在于成为整体。

en: In the purpose what is consequence and result is at the same time the immediately active ground.
It exists as something subjective separated from external determinate being, and the activity consists in translating the subjective form into objectivity.
In this transition the purpose at the same time returns into its concept.
zh: 在目的中，那作为后果与结果的东西同时就是直接起作用的根据。
它作为主观的东西现存着，与外在的定在相分离；而活动就在于把主观的形式译入客观性。
在这一过渡中，目的同时回到它的概念之中。

en: The syllogism of purposive action has three moments: the subjective purpose, the mediation, and the determinate purpose.
Each of these moments is the totality of the universal determinations of the syllogism.
zh: 合目的行动的这个推论有三个环节：主观的目的、中介以及在定的目的。
这三个环节中的每一个都是推论之诸一般规定的总体性。

en: The subjective purpose contains a) the indeterminate free activity of a subject as such, which b) determines itself, or particularizes its universality, and gives itself a determinate content; c) it has the moment of individuality according to which it is negative toward itself, sublates the subjective, and brings forth an external determinate being free from the subject.
zh: 主观的目的包含：a) 一个主体本身的不确定的自由活动，它 b) 规定自身，或说把它的普遍性特殊化，并给予自身一个规定的内容；c) 它具有个别性这一环节，按这一环节它对自身是否定的，它扬弃主观的东西，并产生出一个外在的、脱离主体的定在。

en: The mediation, or the transition into objectivity, has two sides: a) that of objectivity; this is an external thing as means, which is put under the power of the subject, is thereby determined as means, and is turned by it against external determinate being. b) The side of subjectivity is the mediating activity, which on the one hand relates the means to the purpose and subjects it to it, and on the other hand turns it against the other and, by sublatting the determinations of the external, gives determinate being to the purpose.
zh: 中介，或向客观性的过渡，本身具有两个侧面：a) 客观性的侧面；它是一个作为手段的外在之物，它被置于主体的支配之下，因而被规定为手段，并由主体用来反对外在的定在。b) 主观性的侧面是中介着的活动，它一方面把手段关联于目的并使手段服从于目的，另一方面把手段用来反对他物，并通过扬弃外在者的规定给予目的以定在。

en: The executed purpose is a) determinate being of objectivity as such, but b) not merely an immediate determinate being, rather a posited and mediated one, and c) of the same content as the subjective purpose.
zh: 被实现了的目的是 a) 客观性本身的定在，但 b) 它不仅是一个直接的定在，而是一个被设定且被中介了的定在，并且 c) 它与主观的目的具有同一的内容。

en: The defect of this purposive relation is the immediate existence of each of the three moments that enter into relation, for whom therefore the relation and the determinations they receive in it come in externally.
The whole movement of this realization of the concept is therefore as such a subjective action.
As objective action, the realization is the process as the inner relation of the moments of the syllogism according to their own nature.
In the process actual objects stand in relation as independent extremes, whose inner determination, however, is to be by means of others and to join themselves with them.
zh: 这种目的关系的缺陷在于：这三个进入关系的环节中的每一个都直接地存在；因此，对它们来说，那种关系以及它们在其中获得的规定都是从外在附加而来的。
所以概念的这一实现的全部运动总地说来是一种主观的行动。
作为客观的行动，这一实现就是过程，按其自身本性就是推论诸环节的内在关系。
在过程中，现实的对象作为独立的极端处于关系之中；然而它们的内在规定却是：通过他物而存有，并由此与他物结合起来。

en: In mere mechanism objects are joined or altered by a third force, so that this connection or alteration does not already lie in their nature beforehand but is external and contingent to them, and they therefore remain independent in it.
zh: 在单纯的机械作用中，对象由第三种力结合起来或被改变，以致这种结合或改变并非预先就在它们的本性之中，而对它们来说是外在的、偶然的；因此它们在这种情况下仍然保持独立。

en: In chemistry each of the two extremes is a) according to its determinate being a determinate one and at the same time one essentially opposed to the other. b) As something opposed, it is in itself a relation to the other.

It is not only itself, but it also has the determination of existing only as a union with the other; or its nature is in itself tensioned and animated against the other. c) The unity of the extremes is the neutral product which constitutes the ground of their relation and of their entering into the process; but this unity is present in them only as a relation existing in itself.
It does not exist freely for itself before the process.
This is the case in the purpose.
zh: 在化学作用中，两个极端中的每一个 a) 就其定在而言是一个有规定的，并且同时在本质上与另一个相对立。b) 作为对立者，它自在地是对另一个的关系。
它不只就是它自己，而且还具有这样的规定：只作为与另一个的结合而存有；或者说，它的本性自在地处于紧张之中，并针对另一个而鼓动。c) 极端的统一是那个中性的产物，它构成了它们之关系以及它们进入过程的根据；但这个统一在它们之中仅仅作为自在存在的关系而存在。
它在过程面前并不是自由地自为存在。
在目的中正是如此。

en: The higher unity is therefore that the activity maintains itself in the product, or that the product itself is productive, so that the neutralization of the moments is just as much their diremption, or the extinction of the process in the union of the extremes is the rekindling of the same.
The activity of this productive product is therefore self-preservation.
It only brings forth itself, which is already there.
zh: 因此更高的统一在于：活动在产物中保持自身，或者说产物本身是生产性的；因此诸环节的中和同样就是它们的分裂，或者说过程在极端的结合中的熄灭就是该过程的重新点燃。
这个生产性的产物的活动因此就是自我保存。
它只把自己——那个已经在那里者——产生出来。

en: The Idea is the objectively true, or the adequate concept, in which determinate being is determined through the concept inherent in it, and existence as a self-producing product is in outer unity with its purpose.

The Idea is that actuality which does not correspond to any representation or concept existing outside it, but to its own concept, and which is therefore such as it is to be in and for itself and itself contains this its concept. — The Ideal is the Idea considered with respect to the side of existence, but as one which is conformable to the concept.
It is thus the actual in its highest truth. — As opposed to the expression Ideal, one calls Idea rather the true, considered with respect to the side of the concept.
zh: 观念是客观的真理，或者说，是充足的概念；在其中，定在通过它固有的概念而得到规定，而存在作为自行生产的产物与其目的处于外在的统一之中。
观念是这样的现实性：它并不符合任何存在于它之外的表象或概念，而只符合它自己的概念；因此它就是它自在自为所应当的那样，并且自身包含着这个概念。——理想是就存在这一侧面来看的观念，但作为这样一个符合概念的观念。
所以它就是处于最高真理之中的现实者。——与「理想」这一表述相区别，人们更多地把「观念」用于从概念这一侧面来看的真理。

en: There are three Ideas: 1. the Idea of life, 2. the Idea of knowledge and of the good, and 3. the Idea of science or of truth itself.
zh: 有三种观念：1. 生命的观念，2. 认识与善的观念，以及 3. 科学或真理本身的观念。

en: Life is the Idea in its immediate determinate being, by which it enters the field of appearance, or of changeable being that determines itself in manifold ways and externally, and of an inorganic nature.
zh: 生命是观念在其直接定在之中的存在，通过它，观念进入现象的领域，或者说进入那种可变的、以多种多样的方式从外在规定自己的存在的领域，以及一种无机自然的领域。

en: Life, as the immediate unity of concept and determinate being, is such a whole in which the parts are nothing for themselves but through the whole and in the whole, and the whole is just as much through the parts.
It is an organic system.
zh: 生命作为概念与定在的直接统一，是这样一个整体：其中各部分不是为自己而存在，而是通过整体、在整体之中存在；而整体同样是通过各部分而存在的。
它是一个有机的体系。

42.en: II. Idea of Knowledge and of the Good

en: In this Idea the concept and actuality fall apart.

The one, on the one hand, empty in itself, shall receive its determination and fulfilment from actuality; on the other hand, actuality shall receive its determination from the independent determination of that one.
zh: 在这一观念中，概念与现实性彼此分离。
前者一方面就自身而言是空的，应当从现实性获得它的规定和充实；另一方面，现实性应当从前者自身独立的规定中获得它的规定。

en: Knowledge is the relation of concept and actuality.
Thinking, which is in itself filled only with itself and thereby empty, is thereby filled with determinate content, which is lifted from determinate being into universal presentation.
zh: 认识是概念与现实性的关系。
那种自在地只由自身充实、因而是空的思维，由此被特殊的内容所充实，而这一内容是从定在提升为一般表述的。

en: The definition expresses of an object which behaves in it as an individual or particular: its genus as its universal essence, and the particular determinacy of this universal by which it is this object.
zh: 定义表述这样一个对象：它在其中表现为个别者或特殊者；定义表述出它的属作为它一般的本质，以及这个普遍者的特殊规定性——对象正是通过后者而成为这个对象。

en: The division expresses the particularities in which a genus, or a universal as such — a genus, a kind, an order, and so on — exists as a multiplicity of species.
These particularities, which are contained in a unity, must flow from a common principle of division.
zh: 划分表述出一个属、或一个一般者（属、性、秩序等等）作为诸种的杂多而存在时所具有的那些特殊性。
这些包含在一个统一之中的特殊性，必须出自一个共同的划分根据。

en: Knowledge is in part analytic, in part synthetic.
zh: 认识一部分是分析的，一部分是综合的。

en: Analytic knowledge starts from a concept or a determinate determination and develops only the multiplicity of the simple determinations contained in it immediately or identically.
zh: 分析的认识从一个概念或一个具体的规定出发，只展开其中直接地或同一地包含着的那些简单规定的杂多。

en: Synthetic knowledge, on the other hand, develops the determinations of a whole which are not immediately contained in it and do not flow from one another identically, but have the form of difference with respect to one another, and it demonstrates the necessity of their determinate relation to one another.
zh: 综合的认识则相反：它展开一个整体的诸规定，这些规定不是直接包含在其中，也不是同一地从彼此流出，而是彼此之间具有相异的形式；它并且指出这些规定彼此之间那种规定的关系的必然性。

en: This is done by construction and proof.

The construction presents the concept or proposition partly in its real determinations and partly for the sake of the proof presents this its reality in their division and resolution, by which its transition into the concept begins.
zh: 这是通过构造与证明来做的。
构造部分地在其现实的规定中、部分地为证明之故而呈现概念或命题的这一实在性，即在它们的划分与分解中呈现它；由此它们向概念的过渡开始了。

en: The proof takes up the resolved parts and, through the comparison of their relations to one another, brings forth that connection of them which constitutes the relation of the whole expressed in the proposition; or it shows from the real determinations that they are moments of the concept and that their relation to one another taken together presents the concept in its totality.
zh: 证明接过那些分解开的部分，通过对它们彼此关系的比较，产出那种构成定理中所表述的整体之关系的联结；或者它从实在的规定出发指出：它们如何是概念的环节，而它们彼此总括起来的关系如何把概念在其总体性中呈现出来。

en: In this knowledge, which in its strictest form is the geometrical, construction 1. does not arise from the concept but is an invented device which shows itself as purposive only in relation to the proof, or in other cases also an empirical description.
In the proof, synthetic propositions otherwise known or settled for the analytic determinations are fetched from elsewhere, the present is subsumed under them and connected.
The proof thereby acquires the appearance of contingency, since it presents to insight only a necessity, not the own course and inner necessity of the object itself.
zh: 在这种认识中——其最严格的形式是几何的——构造 1. 并不从概念产生，而是一种发明的装置，它只在与证明的关系中才显示为合目的的，在另一些场合则也是一种经验的描述。
在证明中，那些对分析的规定而言原本已知或已成定论的、综合的命题，被从别处引来，现前之物被归摄于它们之下并与之联结。
证明由此获得偶然性的外观，因为就洞察而言它只呈现出一种必然性，而不是对象自身的历程和内在必然性。

en: In the Idea of knowledge the concept is sought, and it is to be adequate to the object.
In the Idea of the good, conversely, the concept counts as the first and as the purpose existing in itself which is to be realized in actuality.
zh: 在认识的观念中，概念被寻求，并且它应当与对象相宜。
在善的观念中则相反，概念被看作第一者，被看作自在存在的、应当在现实性中实现的目的。

en: The good in itself, since it is first to be realized, stands opposed to a world not corresponding to it and to a nature which has its own laws of necessity and is indifferent to the laws of freedom.
zh: 自在的善，由于它首先还须被实现，便面对着一个与它不相称的世界，以及一种自然；这种自然有它自己的必然性法则，并且对自由的法则漠不关心。

en: The good, as absolute purpose, is on the one hand to be accomplished in itself without any regard for the consequences, in that it is entrusted to an actuality which is independent of it and can invert it.
zh: 善作为绝对的目的，一方面自在地应当完成，不顾及一切后果；它被托付给一种独立于它、并且能够颠倒它的现实性。

en: At the same time, however, there lies in this the determination that in itself actuality agrees with the good, or the belief in a moral world-order.
zh: 但同时这里面含着这样一个规定：自在地现实性与善相一致，或者说，对一种道德的世界秩序的信仰。

73.en: III. Idea of Knowledge or of Truth
73.zh: III. 知识的观念或真理的观念

en: Absolute knowledge is the concept which has itself for object and content, thus is its own reality.
zh: 绝对的知识是那个以自身为对象、以自身为内容的概念，因此就是它自己的实在性。

en: The course or method of absolute knowledge is just as much analytic as synthetic.

The development of what is contained in the concept, the analysis, is the coming forth of different determinations which are contained in the concept but are not immediately given as such, thus at the same time synthetic.

The presentation of the concept in its real determinations here proceeds from the concept itself, and what in ordinary knowledge constitutes the proof is here the return of the moments of the concept that have passed into difference back into the unity, which thereby is the totality, the fulfilled concept that has become its own content.
zh: 绝对知识的进程或方法同样是分析的和综合的。
对概念中所含之物的展开，即分析，是各种不同的规定的出现；这些规定包含在概念之中，但不是作为这样的规定直接地被给予，因此同时是综合的。
概念在其实在的规定中的表述在这里是从概念自身产生的；而在通常的认识中构成证明的东西，在这里就是那些过渡到相异中的概念环节返回统一，这一统一因此就是总体性，就是那个被充实了的、并且成为自身内容的概念。

en: This mediation of the concept with itself is not only a course of subjective knowledge but just as much the own movement of the thing itself.
In absolute knowledge the concept begins just as much as it is result.
zh: 概念与自身的这一中介不仅是主观认识的一个进程，而且同样是事情自身的运动。
在绝对的认识中，概念既是一个开端，也同样是一个结果。

en: The progression to further concepts or to a new sphere is likewise guided by the preceding one and necessary.
The concept which has become reality is at the same time again a unity which must present in itself the movement of realization.

But the development of the opposition contained in it is not a mere dissolution into the moments from which it has become, but rather these moments now have a different form by virtue of having passed through the unity.
In the new development they are now posited as what they are through their relation to one another.
They have thus received a new determination.
zh: 向更进一步的概念或向一个新领域的进展，同样是由先前那个所引导的，因而是必然的。
那个成为实在性的概念同时又是一个统一，它本身须呈现出实现的运动。
但其中所包含的对立的展开并不是单纯地分解为它由此变成的那些环节；相反，这些环节由于经过了统一，如今具有了另一种形态。
在新的展开中，它们如今被设定为它们通过彼此关系所是的东西。
因此它们获得了一个新的规定。

en: The science of logic has for its object thinking and the scope of its determinations.
Natural logic one calls the natural understanding which man as such has by nature and the immediate use he makes of it.
The science of logic, however, is knowledge of thinking in its truth.
zh: 逻辑学这门科学以思维及其诸规定的范围为对象。
所谓自然的逻辑，人们指的是人本来就由自然具有的那种自然知性，以及他对它所作的直接运用。
但逻辑学这门科学乃是对思维在其真理之中的知识。

en: Explanation.
Logic considers the domain of thought as such.
Thinking is its own sphere.
It is a whole in itself.
The content of logic is the proper determinations of thinking itself, which have no ground at all other than thinking.
What is alien to it is something given through representation as such.
Logic is therefore a great science.
It must indeed be distinguished between pure thought and reality; but reality, insofar as the true actuality is understood under it, the thought has it too.
But insofar as by this only sensible, external determinate being is meant, it has even a much higher reality.

Thinking thus has a content, and that is itself in an autonomous way. — Through the study of logic one also learns to think more correctly, for in thinking the thinking of thinking, the mind thereby acquires its strength.
One learns to know the nature of thinking, by which one can sniff out when thinking is willing to let itself be seduced into error.
One must know how to render account of one's own doing.
Thereby one attains firmness not to let oneself be confused by others.
zh: 解释。
逻辑学考察思维一般的领域。
思维是它自己的领域。
它是一个自为的整体。
逻辑学的内容是思维自身的特有规定，这些规定除了思维之外根本没有别的根据。
对思维而言的他律之物，是通过表象一般地被给予的东西。
所以逻辑学是一门伟大的科学。
诚然必须区分纯粹的思维与实在性；但是，只要在实在性之下所理解的是真正的现实性，那么思维也有这种实在性。
但如果这里仅仅指的是感性的、外在的定在，那么它甚至有一种高得多的实在性。
所以思维有一个内容，而且是以自主的方式以自身为内容。——通过研究逻辑学，人也学会更正确地思考，因为当我们在思维「思维之思维」时，精神由此就获得自己的力量。
人由此学会认识思维的本性，从而能够嗅出思维何时甘愿被诱入错误。
人必须知道为自己的行动作出说明。
由此人便获得坚定，不再让自己被别人弄糊涂。

en: Thinking is as such the grasping and summarizing of the manifold into the one.
The manifold as such belongs to externality as such, to feeling and to sensible intuition.
zh: 思维一般地就是把握杂多并把杂多总括到统一之中。
杂多作为这样的杂多属于外在性，属于感觉和感性直观。

en: Explanation.
Thinking consists in bringing all the manifold into the one.
In thinking about things, the mind brings them down to the simple forms which are the pure determinations of the mind.
The manifold is at first external to thinking.
Insofar as we grasp the sensibly manifold, we do not yet think; rather only the relating of it is thinking.
The immediate grasping of the manifold we call feeling or sensation.
When I feel, I know only of something; in intuition, however, I look at something as something external to me in space and in time.
Feeling becomes intuition when it is determined spatially and temporally.
zh: 解释。
思维在于把一切杂多带入统一之中。
精神在思维诸事物时，把它们归结为那些简单的形式，而这些形式是精神的纯粹规定。
杂多首先是思维的外在物。
就我们把握感性的杂多而言，我们还没有在思维；只有把杂多联系起来才是思维。
我们对杂多的直接把握，我们称之为感觉或感受。
当我感觉时，我只知道有某种东西；但在直观中，我直观到某种东西作为在空间中、在时间中对我外在的东西。
感觉在受到空间和时间的限定时就成为直观。

en: Thinking is abstraction insofar as the understanding starts from concrete intuitions, omits one of the manifold determinations and brings out another, giving it the simple form of thinking.
zh: 思维就是抽象，就理智从具体的直观出发、舍去那些多种多样的规定之一而突出另一个，并赋予它思维的简单形式而言。

en: Explanation.
If I omit all determinations from an object, nothing remains.
If, on the other hand, I omit one determination and bring out another, this is abstract.
The I, for example, is an abstract determination.
I know only of the I insofar as I separate myself from all determinations.
But this is a negative means.
I negate the determinations of myself and let myself remain only as such.
Abstracting is the negative side of thinking.
zh: 解释。
如果我把一个对象的所有规定都舍去，那么什么也不剩下。
相反，如果我舍去一个规定而突出另一个，那么这就是抽象的。
例如，自我就是一个抽象的规定。
就我把自己从一切规定中分离出来而言，我只知道自我。
但这是一种否定性的手段。
我否定掉我身上的种种规定，只让我自己作为这样的自我留存下来。
抽象是思维的否定方面。

en: The content of representations is taken from experience, but the form of the unity itself and its further determinations have not their sources in the immediacy of the same as such, but in thinking.
zh: 表象的内容取自经验；但统一本身的形式及其更进一步的规定，并不是在经验本身的直接性中有其来源，而是在思维中。

en: Explanation.
The I means thinking as such.
When I say: I think, this is something identical.
The I is completely simple.
I am thinking, and indeed always.
But we cannot say: I think always.
In itself perhaps, but our object is not always also thought.
But we can say in the sense that we are the I that we think always, for the I is always the simple identity with itself, and that is thinking.
As the I we are the ground of all our determinations.
Insofar as an object is thought, it receives the form of thinking and becomes a thought object.
It is made equal to the I, i.e. it is thought.
zh: 解释。
自我一般地就意味着思维。
当我说：自我在思维，这就是一个同一的东西。
自我是完全简单的。
我是在思维的，而且始终如此。
但我们不能说：自我始终在思维。
自在地或许可以，但我们的对象并不总是也是思维。
但我们可以在「我们是自我」这个意义上说：我们始终在思维，因为自我始终是它与自身的简单同一，而这正是思维。
作为自我，我们是我们一切规定的根据。
就一个对象被思维而言，它就获得思维的形式，并成为一个被思维的对象。
它被与自我等同起来，即它被思维。

en: This is not to be understood as if this unity first came to the manifold of the objects through thinking and the interconnection were first brought in from outside; rather the unity belongs just as much to the object and together with its determinations also constitutes its own nature.
zh: 这不应被理解为：仿佛这个统一只是通过思维才来到对象的杂多面前，而这种联结才从外面被带入其中；毋宁说这个统一同样属于对象，并且连同它的规定一起构成对象自身的本性。

en: There are three things of thought: 1. the categories; 2. the determinacies of reflection; 3. the concepts.
The doctrine of the first two constitutes objective logic or metaphysics; the doctrine of the concepts the proper or subjective logic.
zh: 思维有三者：1. 范畴；2. 反思规定；3. 概念。
前两者的学说构成客观逻辑或形而上学；关于概念的学说则是本来的即主观的逻辑。

en: Explanation.
Logic contains the system of pure thinking.
Being is 1. the immediate, 2. the inner; the determinations of thought return again into themselves.
The objects of ordinary metaphysics are the thing, the world, the mind, and God, whence the various metaphysical sciences arise: ontology, cosmology, pneumatology, and theology.
zh: 解释。
逻辑学包含纯粹思维的体系。
存在 1. 是直接的，2. 是内在的；思维的规定又返回自身。
通常形而上学的对象是物、世界、精神和上帝，由此产生各种形而上学科学：本体论、宇宙论、灵魂论与神学。

en: What the concept presents is a being, but also something essential.
Being relates itself, as the immediate, to essence as the mediated.
Things are altogether, but their being consists in showing their essence.
Being makes itself into essence, which can also be expressed thus: being presupposes essence.
But even if essence appears in relation to being as the mediated, essence is nevertheless the original.
Being in it returns into its ground; being sublates itself in essence.
Its essence is in this way something that has come to be or been brought forth, but rather what appears as having come to be is also the original.
The transient has essence as its ground and comes to be from it.
zh: 概念所表述的是存在者，但也是一个本质性的东西。
存在作为直接者，与本质作为被中介者相对待。
事物总归是存在着，但它们的存在在于显示它们的本质。
存在使自己成为本质，这也可以这样表达：存在预设了本质。
但即便本质相对于存在而言显现为被中介者，本质毕竟才是最初者。
存在在本质中返回自己的根据；存在在本质中扬弃自身。
存在的本质以这种方式是一个已成之物或被产生出来之物；但毋宁说，那个作为已成之物而显现的东西，同样就是最初者。
易逝者以本质为它的根据，并由它产生。

en: We make concepts.
These are something posited by us, but the concept also contains the thing in and for itself.
In relation to it essence is again the posited, but the posited nevertheless relates itself as true.
The concept is partly the subjective, partly the objective.
The Idea is the union of the subjective and the objective.
When we say it is a mere concept, we miss reality in it.
Mere objectivity, on the other hand, is something conceptless.
The Idea, however, indicates how reality is determined through the concept.
Everything actual is an Idea.
zh: 我们制造概念。
这些是由我们设定出来的东西，但概念也包含着事情自在自为本身。
相对于概念，本质又是那个被设定者；但被设定者毕竟表现为真。
概念一部分是主观的，一部分是客观的。
观念是主观与客观的统一。
当我们说它只是一个纯粹的概念时，我们就在其中失去了实在性。
相反，纯粹的客观性乃是无概念的。
而观念则表明实在性如何通过概念而得到规定。
一切现实者都是一种观念。

en: Science presupposes that the separation of itself from truth is already sublated, or that the mind no longer belongs to appearance, as it is considered in the doctrine of consciousness.

The certainty of itself embraces everything that is an object for consciousness, be it an external thing or a thought brought forth out of the mind, insofar as it does not contain in itself all the moments of being-in-and-for-self: to be in itself, or simple equality with itself; to have determinate being, being-for-other; and to be for itself, in which being-other is simply returned into itself and so to be at home with itself.
Science does not seek truth but is in truth and is truth itself.
zh: 科学预设：它与真理之间的分离已经被扬弃；或者说，精神不再像在意识学说中所考察的那样属于现象。
它自身的确定性包括一切对于意识是对象的东西，无论那是外在之物，还是从精神中产生出来的思想——只要它没有在自身中包含自在自为存在的诸环节：自在地存在，或与自身简单等同；具有定在或规定性，即为他存在的存在；以及为他自己而存在，即在「他在」中简单地返回自身并安顿于自身。
科学并不寻求真理，而是就在真理之中，并且就是真理本身。

en: Quality is the immediate determinacy whose alteration is the passing over into an opposite.
zh: 质是直接的规定性，它的改变就是过渡到一个对立者。

en: Being is the simple contentless immediacy which has its opposite in pure nothing, and the union of the two is becoming: as the passing over of nothing into being, the arising; conversely, the perishing.
zh: 存在是简单的、无内容的直接性，它在纯粹的无之中有着自己的对立者；而两者的统一就是生成：作为从无到存在的过渡，就是产生；反之则是消逝。

en: (Sound common sense, as one-sided abstraction often calls itself, denies the union of being and nothing: either being is, or it is not; there is no third thing; what is does not begin, nor does what is not.
It therefore asserts the impossibility of beginning.)
zh: （那种健全的常识——单方面的抽象常常这样自称——否认存在与无的统一：要么存在存在，要么它不存在；没有第三种东西；存在者并不开始，非存在者也不开始。
因此它断言开端是不可能的。）

en: Determinate being is a becoming, determinate being, a being which at the same time has a relation to the other, thus to its non-being.
zh: 定在是生成了的、被规定了的存在的存在，是一种同时对他者、因而对自己的非存在具有关系的存在。

en: a) Determinate being is therefore something divided in itself.
On the one hand it is in itself, on the other hand it is a relation to the other.
Determinate being, thought with these two determinations, is reality.
zh: a) 因此定在是一个在自身中分开了的东西。
一方面它是自在的，另一方面它是对他者的关系。
定在被思为具有这两项规定时，就是实在性。

en: b) Something that is there has a relation to the other.
The other is a determinate being as the non-being of something.
It thus has at first a limit or boundary and is finite.
How something is to be in itself is its determination.
zh: b) 某物，即在那里的东西，对他者具有一种关系。
他者是一个作为某物之非存在的定在。
因此它首先具有一个界限或者说一个限度，并且是有限的。
某物应当如何自在地存在，就是它的规定。

en: How something is for the other, how it is connected with the other, thus how it is immediately in itself also posited through the other, is its constitution.
zh: 某物对他者是如何的，它与他者如何相联系，因而它自在地如何直接地也通过他者被设定，这就是它的性质。

en: How something is in itself both in itself and for the other, is its determinacy or quality.
The limit is not merely a mere ceasing but belongs to the something in itself.
zh: 某物如何既自在地又为他者而在自身中，这就是它的规定性或质。
界限不仅是单纯的停止，而且属于某物本身。

en: c) Through its quality, through what it is, something is subject to alteration.
It alters itself insofar as its determinacy in connection with the other becomes constitution.
zh: c) 某物通过它的质、通过它所是的东西，服从于改变。
它发生改变，就其规定性在与另一个的联系中成为性质而言。

en: Insofar as alteration as such sublates constitution, alteration itself is sublated.
Being has thus returned into itself and shuts the other out from itself.
It is for itself.
zh: 就改变扬弃了一般性质而言，改变本身也被扬弃。
存在由此返回了自身，并把他者关在自身之外。
它是为他自身而存在的。

en: It is the One which relates itself only to itself and behaves toward the other as repulsive.
zh: 它是一，它只与自身相关，并对他者表现出排斥。

en: This exclusion is at the same time a relation to the other and therefore behaves at the same time attractively.
No repulsion without attraction and conversely.
zh: 这种排除同时是一种对他者的关系，因此同时又表现出吸引。
没有吸引就没有排斥，反之亦然。

en: Or with the repulsion of the one there are immediately posited many ones.
But the many ones are not distinguished from one another.
One is what the other is.
It is just as much their sublation; attraction is posited.
zh: 或者，随着一的排斥，直接就设定了多个一。
但这些多个一彼此并没有区别。
一就是其他者所是的。
它同样就是它们的扬弃；吸引被设定了。

en: The one is the being-for-itself which distinguishes itself absolutely from others.
But insofar as this difference, the repulsion, is sublated through attraction, the difference is posited as sublated and has thereby passed over into another determination, quantity.
zh: 一是那个自为存在者，它绝对地与他人相区别。
但就这一差别——即排斥——通过吸引而自行扬弃而言，这差别被设定为已被扬弃，并因此过渡到另一个规定——量。

en: (Something has no significance without its limit.
If I change the limit of something, it no longer remains what it is.
If I change the limit of a field, the field remains what it is and merely becomes somewhat larger.
Here, however, I have not changed its limit as a field but as a quantum.
To change its size as a field would mean, for example, making it into a forest.)
zh: （某物没有它的界限就没有意义。
如果我改变某物的界限，它就不再是它所是的东西。
如果我改变一块田的界限，这块田仍然是它所是的东西，只不过变大了一些。
但在这里，我并不是把它作为田来改变界限，而是作为量数来改变。
把它作为田来改变大小，例如就是把它变成树林。）

en: Through quality something is what it is.
Through an alteration of quality not merely a determination of something, or of the finite, is altered but the finite itself.
Quantity, on the other hand, is the determination which no longer constitutes the nature of the thing itself but an indifferent difference, in the alteration of which the thing remains what it is.
zh: 某物通过质而成为它所是的东西。
通过质的改变，发生改变的不只是某物上的一个规定、或者说有限者身上的一个规定，而是有限者本身。
相反，量是这样一种规定：它不再构成事情自身的本性，而是一种无关紧要的差别；在它改变的时候，事情仍然是它所是的东西。

en: Quantity is the sublated being-for-itself, or the One.
It is thus an uninterrupted continuity in itself.
But since it also contains the One just as much, it also has the moment of discreteness in itself.
zh: 量是自为存在——即一——的扬弃。
因此它是在自身中不间断的连续性。
但由于它同样包含着一，它自身也就包含着离散性这一环节。

en: a) Magnitude is either continuous or discrete.

But each of these two kinds of magnitude has both discreteness and continuity in it, and the difference is only this: that in discrete magnitude discreteness, in continuous magnitude however continuity constitutes the principle.
zh: a) 量要么是连续的，要么是离散的。
但这两种量中的每一种都既有离散性又有连续性，两者的差别仅在于：在离散的量中离散性构成原则，而在连续的量中则是连续性构成原则。

en: b) Magnitude or quantity, as limited quantity, is a quantum.
Since this limit is nothing determined in and for itself, a quantum can be increased or diminished into the indeterminate.
zh: b) 量，或量，作为有界限的量就是一个量数。
由于这个界限自在自为地并不是任何规定，一个量数就可以朝不确定的方向增加或减少。

en: The limit of the quantum in the form of being-in-itself gives intensive magnitude, in the form of externality extensive magnitude.
But there is no intensive which does not also have the form of extensive determinate being, and conversely.
zh: 量数的界限在自身存在的形式下给出内涵的量，在外在性的形式下给出外延的量。
但不存在这样一种内涵者，它不同时具有外延定在的形式；反之亦然。

en: c) The quantum has no limit determined in itself.
Thus there is no quantum over which a larger or smaller one could not be posited.
The quantum which is to be the last, over which no larger or smaller is to be posited, is usually called the infinitely large or the infinitely small.
zh: c) 量数没有自在地由自身规定的界限。
因此不存在这样一个量数：在它之上不能设定一个更大的或更小的量数。
那个应当是最后一个、在其之上不再设定更大或更小者的量数，通常被称为无限的大或无限的小。

en: But thereby it ceases altogether to be a quantum and is = 0 for itself.
It still has significance only as a determination of a relation in which it no longer has a magnitude for itself but only a determination in relation to something other.
This is the more precise concept of the mathematically infinite.
zh: 但这样它就完全不再是一个量数，并且为他自身而言 = 0。
它作为某种关系的一个规定才还有意义；在这一关系中，它为他自身而言不再有大小，而只有相对于他物的一个规定。
这就是数学的无限更为精确的概念。

en: The infinite as such is in the infinite progression at first the sublation of the limit, be it a qualitative or a quantitative one, so that this limit counts as something positive and therefore keeps arising again against the negation.
The true infinite, however, is, insofar as the limit is taken as negation, the negation of the negation.
In it, by passing beyond the finite, no new limit is posited again, but rather by the sublation of the limit determinate being is restored to equality with itself.
zh: 无限一般地在无限的进展中首先是界限的扬弃，无论这界限是质的还是量的；以致这界限被看作肯定的东西，因此总是针对否定而重新产生。
但真正的无限，就界限被理解为否定而言，是否定的否定。
在它之中，通过越过有限者，并不再设定一个新的界限，而是通过界限的扬弃，把定在恢复为与自身等同。

en: Insofar as the quantum sublates itself in the infinite, this has the significance that the indifferent external determination which constitutes the quantum is sublated and becomes an internal, a qualitative determination.
zh: 就量数在无限中扬弃自身而言，这意味着：构成量数的那种无关紧要的外在规定被扬弃了，并成为一种内在的、质的规定。

en: The measure is a determinate quantum, insofar as it is determined not externally but through the nature of the thing, through quality.
zh: 度是一个特定的量数，就它不是从外部、而是通过事情的本性、通过质而得到规定而言。

en: In the alteration of a quantum, in the increase or decrease that falls within the measure, there also enters a specification, in that the external indifferent waxing and waning of magnitude is at the same time determined and modified by the nature of the thing from itself.
zh: 在量数的改变中、在落入度之内的增加或减少中，同样发生一种特定化：因为大小的外在的、无关紧要的消长同时也由事情的本性从自身出发得到规定并被修改。

en: Insofar as the measure of a thing is altered, the thing itself is altered, and something disappears through the surpassing of its measure, through its waxing or waning beyond the same.
zh: 就一个事物的度被改变而言，该事物本身就改变了；有某种东西通过越过自己的度、通过超出它而增多或减少而消失。

en: Essence is being that has returned into itself out of its immediacy, whose determinations are sublated into simple unity.
zh: 本质是从其直接性中返回到自身内的存在，它的诸规定被扬弃到简单的统一之中。

168.en: First Section The Determinations of Essence
168.zh: 第一节 本质的诸规定

en: Determinations, insofar as they belong to immediate being and are not contained in the inner unity, are distinguished from essence as inessential.
zh: 诸规定，就它们属于直接的存在、而不包含在内在的统一之中而言，被与本质区分开来，作为非本质的东西。

en: Insofar as the essential determinations are contained in the unity of essence, the determinate being of the same is a being posited, i.e. they are not immediate and for themselves in their determinate being but mediated.
There are therefore determinations of thought in the form of reflections.
zh: 就本质性的规定包含在本质的统一之中而言，它们的定在就是被设定着的存在，即它们在自己的定在中不是直接地、不是为他自身而存在，而是被中介了的。
因此有以反思为形式的思维规定。

en: The first determination is the essential unity with itself; identity.
As the proposition of identity: A = A; or negatively, expressed as the proposition of contradiction: A cannot at the same time be A and not A.
zh: 第一个规定是与自身的本质统一；即同一性。
作为同一律的命题：A = A；或者否定地、作为矛盾律的命题表达出来：A 不能同时是 A 又是非 A。

en: The determination of difference, of a determinate being that is indifferent to one another and distinguished by some determinacy.
The proposition which expresses them runs: there are not two things which are equal to one another.
zh: 相异的规定，即一种彼此无关紧要的、并通过某个规定性而相区别开的定在的规定。
表达它们的命题是：不存在两个彼此相等的东西。

en: The opposition56) ; as positive and negative, in which the determinacy of the one is posited only through the determinacy of another, of which each is at the same time what it is insofar as the other is, but is only what it is insofar as it is not the other.
Expressed in a proposition: something is either A or not A, there is no third thing.
(The proposition exclusi tertii.)
zh: 对立56)；作为肯定与否定，其中一方的规定性只是通过另一方的规定性才被设定，而这一方同时正是就另一方而言它所是的东西，但只有就它不是另一方时它才所是。
用一个命题表达出来：某物要么是 A，要么不是 A，没有第三种东西。
（排中律命题。）

en: The third, in which the posited determinations as such are sublated, is essence, which is ground insofar as.
zh: 那第三者——其中被设定的诸规定作为规定被扬弃了——就是本质，就此而言它是根据。

en: The proposition of ground runs: everything has its sufficient ground.
zh: 根据律的命题是：一切都有其充足根据。

en: (The ground is the positing as such, insofar through something thereby comes to determinate being; this is no transition into opposite determinations, as becoming is in being, but in it there is a unity of relation; although the posited determinate being can at the same time have a form different from its ground, it must nevertheless at the same time be contained in it.)
zh: （根据是设定本身，就某种东西通过它而获得定在而言；这不是像生成在存在中那样过渡到相反的规定，而是在其中有着关系的统一；虽然被设定的定在同时可以具有与它的根据不同的形态，但它毕竟同时必须包含在其中。）

en: Insofar as immediate determinate being is considered as merely something posited, one passes over from it into essence or to the ground; the former is here the first, that from which one starts; but in this return what it is to be the first is rather sublated, and the ground is recognized as the first and essential.
zh: 就直接的定在被看作仅仅是被设定的东西而言，人们就从它过渡到本质、亦即过渡到根据；前者在这里是第一者，即人们由之出发者；但在这一返回中，「它是第一者」这一点毋宁被扬弃了，而根据被认作第一的和本质性的东西。

en: The ground contains that which is founded through it according to its essential determinations; the relation of the ground and the founded is a [unity] and not a transition into the opposite, although the founded determinate being has a form different from its ground, which is likewise a determinate being; and the main determination is their common content.
zh: 根据按其本质规定包含着通过它而被奠基的东西；根据与被奠基者的关系是一个[统一]，而不是过渡到对立者，虽然被奠基的定在具有与它的根据（根据同样是一个定在）不同的形态；而主要的规定则是二者共同的内容。

en: Properly speaking, this alone belongs here: that something makes itself into a ground.
zh: 严格说来，只有这一点属于这里：有某种东西把自己作为根据。

en: The ground is at first the simple unity of different determinations, so that in it they are not apart from one another, not separated from each other.
They have in it the form of being sublated; and it constitutes their existence.
This whole as existing is a thing of many properties
zh: 根据首先是不同的规定之简单统一，以致它们在其中不是彼此在外、不是彼此分离。
它们在其中有着已被扬弃的形式；而根据构成它们的存在。
这个作为存在着的整体就是一个具有许多属性的物

en: The thing emerges from the ground into determinate being insofar as the ground is the positing that has returned into itself, or the difference that has become identical with itself, thus the restored immediacy, a determinate being which is itself not immediate but can be called existence.
zh: 物从根据过渡到定在，就根据是那返回到自身之内的设定、或者说那已与自身成为同一的差别、因而是那被恢复的直接性而言；这是一个本身并非直接的、而是可以称作存在的定在。

en: Existence is mediated through the sublated mediation; the ground perishes in its existence; (that the ground does not perish, we suppose, because according to its content it remains).
zh: 存在通过那被扬弃了的中介而被中介；根据在它的存在中毁灭；（我们设想根据并不丢失，因为就其内容而言它留存着。）

en: The properties of the thing are determinations of its existence which have an indifferent difference from one another; and likewise the thing, as simple identity with itself, is undetermined and indifferent toward them as determinations.
zh: 物的诸属性是它的存在的诸规定，它们彼此之间有着无关紧要的相异；而物，作为与自身的简单同一，同样是无规定的，并且相对于它们作为规定而言是漠不关心的。

en: The indifference of their existence is the thing, which also means: the thing is before it exists.
zh: 它们存在的漠不关心就是物；也可以说：物在它存在之前就已经在了。

en: The determinations are identical with themselves through the thinghood; and the thing is nothing other than this identity of them with themselves; for this identity taken in isolation has no truth for itself.
The thing thus dissolves into its properties as into matters existing for themselves.
zh: 诸规定通过物性而与自身同一；而物无非就是它们与自身的这一同一；因为这一同一单独来看对他自身没有真理。
因此物就在其诸属性中分解为自为存在的诸物质。

en: Insofar, however, as the matters are united into the unity of one thing, they penetrate one another mutually (are absolutely porous) and dissolve into one another.
The thing is thus this contradiction within itself, or posited as something that only dissolves in itself, as appearance.
zh: 但由于诸物质被统一到一个物之中，它们彼此相互贯穿（是绝对多孔的）并相互分解。
所以物就是自在的矛盾，或被设定为一个仅仅在自身中分解的东西，即现象。

en: The identity with itself which is both the thing and the matters is dissolved; the determinations are therefore such as are not in themselves but only in an other; they are only as posited, as appearance.
zh: 那既曾是物又曾是诸物质的与自身的同一被分解了；因此诸规定是这样一些规定：它们自在地并不存在，而只在另一个中存在；它们只是作为被设定的东西、作为现象而存在。

en: The identity with itself in appearance is the undetermined and the simply capable of determination, the passive, matter; the identity of the determinations in their relation to one another constitutes the active, the form.
zh: 现象中的与自身的同一是不确定者、以及单纯能够接受规定者，即被动者、物质；而诸规定在彼此关系中的同一则构成主动者，即形式。

en: Essence must appear, once because determinate being dissolves in itself and returns into its ground, — negative appearance; the other time insofar as essence, as ground, is simple immediacy and thereby being as such. — For the sake of the identity of ground and existence, there is nothing in appearance which is not in essence, and conversely nothing in essence which is not in appearance.
zh: 本质必须显现出来：一次是因为定在自身中分解并返回其根据——否定性的现象；另一次则是因为本质作为根据就是简单的直接性，并因此是存在本身。——为了根据与存在的同一，现象中没有任何东西是不在本质中的，反之本质中也没有任何东西是不在现象中的。

en: Insofar as matter is determined by form, both are presupposed as independent of and independent of one another.
But there is no form at all without matter and no matter without form. {Matter and form generate one another reciprocally.}
zh: 就物质由形式而得到规定而言，两者都被预设为各自独立、并且彼此独立。
但根本没有无物质的形式，也没有无形式的物质。{物质与形式相互产生。}

en: Eternity of matter.
zh: 物质的永恒性。

en: Form determines matter; it is active toward the same as toward an other.
This activity is a reflecting in a twofold way:
zh: 形式规定物质；它作为对一个他者而对物质发生作用。
这种活动是双重的反思：

en: The form posits determinations into matter; these determinations receive existence in it, or rather it constitutes this existence of the same itself.
They remain, however, in this externality (belonging to the form) related to their unity or are reflected, and the form remains as such in its unity with itself.
zh: 形式把诸规定设定到物质之中；这些规定在物质中获得存有，或者毋宁说，形式构成它们自身的这一存有。
但这些规定在这种外在性中（属于形式）仍然关联于它们的统一，或者说仍是被反思着的；而形式总体上仍处在它与自身的统一之中。

en: Insofar as form relates itself to matter, it relates itself to it at the same time as to an other.

But matter is the identity with itself; form thus relates itself as determining to the identity with itself or reflects itself into itself by means of it, and this identity is first brought about through this reflection.

Matter is therefore produced through the determining of form.59) It is thus the presupposed of the determining, but a presupposition which is sublated through the activity of form and is made into the result.
zh: 就形式与物质相关而言，它同时把物质当作一个他者而与它相关。
但物质是与自身的同一；因此形式作为规定者而与它自身的同一相关，或者说它借此把自身反思到自身之中，而这一同一正是通过这种反思才产生的。
所以物质是通过形式的规定而产生出来的。59) 因此物质是规定的前提，但这一前提通过形式的活动被扬弃并成为结果。

en: The form is finite insofar as it stands opposed to force; it has in it its limit; likewise matter, outside of which the form is, is finite matter. — The form behaves positively and negatively toward matter and toward itself; α) toward matter, αα) positively, it posits its own determinations, ββ) negatively, it sublates the undeterminedness of matter; β) toward itself, αα) positively, it posits its own determinations, reflection into itself; ββ) negatively, it sublates its negative identity with itself; it gives its determinations existence, materiality.
zh: 形式是有限的，就它与力相对立而言；它在自身中有着自己的界限；同样，形式之外的那个物质也是有限的物质。——形式相对于物质和相对于自身都表现出肯定与否定：α) 相对于物质，αα) 肯定地，它设定自己的诸规定，ββ) 否定地，它扬弃物质的不确定性；β) 相对于自身，αα) 肯定地，它设定自己的诸规定，即对自身的反思；ββ) 否定地，它扬弃自身与自身的那个否定同一；它给予其诸规定以存有，即物质性。

en: In this essential unity of form and matter, form is, as the necessary relation of its determinations, the law of appearance.
zh: 在形式与物质的这一本质统一中，形式作为其诸规定的必然关系，就是现象的规律。

en: Form and matter are inessential insofar as they are separated from the thing, from its unity.
The appearing, as posited under the determination of form, the formed, constitutes the content which is distinguished from the form itself in that this appears toward it as an external relation.
zh: 形式与物质，就它们与物、与物的统一相分离而言是非本质的。
显现者、作为被规定在形式之下的那个成形者，构成内容；这内容与形式本身相区别，因为形式对它而言表现为一种外在的关系。

en: Insofar as further the determinations posited through form are identical with themselves, or material, they appear as an independent existence, and their relation to one another constitutes the ratio.
zh: 进一步，就形式所设定的诸规定与自身同一、即是物质性的而言，它们表现为一种独立的存在；而它们彼此之间的关系就构成了这种关系。

en: Form and matter here are not distinguished from one another but from their unity.
zh: 在这里，形式与物质不是彼此相区别，而是与它们的统一相区别。

en: The ratio is a relation of two sides to one another which in part have an indifferent existence but in part each is only through the other and in this unity of being determined.
zh: 关系是两个方面彼此的一种联系：一方面它们有着无关紧要的存有，另一方面每一方又只是通过另一方、并在这种被规定的统一中才是它所是的。

en: Ratio is appearance.
zh: 关系就是现象。

en: The determinations are posited on the one hand in the form of the ratio; on the other hand they are only in themselves these determinations of form and appear as an independent immediate existence; in this respect they are a presupposed determinate being which already contains in itself internally the totality of the form, which can have existence only through that presupposed determinate being, or they are insofar conditions and the ratio a conditioned ratio.
zh: 诸规定一方面被设定在关系的形式中；另一方面它们自在地只是形式的这些规定，并表现为一种独立的直接存在。就这一方面而言，它们是一个被预设的定在，它在内在方面已经包含着形式的总体性，而这一总体性只有通过那个被预设的定在才能获得存在；或者说它们就此而言是条件，而关系则是一个有条件的关系。

en: In the conditions and in the conditioned ratio appearance begins to return into essence and being-in-itself; but in it the difference of appearance as such and of appearance insofar as it is in itself is still present.
zh: 在诸条件中、在有条件的关系中，现象开始返回本质与自在存在；但在其中，现象作为现象与现象自在地是它之间的相异仍然留存着。

en: The immediate conditioned ratio is the ratio of the whole and the parts; the parts, as existing for themselves apart from the ratio, are mere matter and are insofar not parts; as parts they have their determination only in the whole, and in order to be able to be parts they must also be capable in and for themselves of entering into this ratio with the whole; and insofar the parts constitute the whole.
zh: 直接的有条件的关系就是整体与部分的关系；部分作为脱离关系而自为存在的，只是单纯的物质，并就此而言不是部分；作为部分，它们的规定只在全体之中；而为了能够是部分，它们自在自为地也必须能够进入与整体的这种关系之中；而部分就此构成整体。

en: The whole as inner active form is force; it has no external matter as its condition but is in matter itself.60) Its condition is only an external impulse which is to solicit it.

This is itself an expression of a force and requires a solicitation in order to appear; there is thus present a mutual conditioning and being conditioned, which is thus unconditioned in the whole.:61)
zh: 整体作为内在的活动形式就是力；它没有外在的物质作为自己的条件，而是就在物质本身之中。60) 它的条件只是一个外在的推动力，它须由这推动力来鼓动。
后者本身就是力的一个表现，并且为了显现出来还需要一次鼓动；因此存在着相互的条件作用与被条件作用，而这在全体中就是无条件的。：61)

en: According to its content, force, since as form it contains its determinations in itself, presents in its expression what it is in itself, and there is nothing in its expression which is not in its interior.
zh: 就内容而言，力由于作为形式而把它的诸规定包含在自身之中，就在其表现中呈现出它自在地所是的东西；而它的表现中没有任何东西是不在其内在之中的。

en: The content, which is thus unconditioned, relates itself as the inner only to itself as the outer; the outer and the inner are the same, only considered from different sides; the inner is the completeness of the content-determinations as conditions which themselves have determinate being; the becoming-outer is itself the reflection of the same into itself, the coming together into the unity of a whole which thereby receives existence.
zh: 因此这无条件的内容，作为内在者只与作为外在者的自身相关；外在与内在是同一个东西，只是从不同方面来看；内在者是诸内容规定作为条件的完备性，而这些条件自身具有定在；成为外在者本身就是它们对自身的反思，就是它们结成一个整体的合一，而这个全体由此获得存在。

en: Substance is the unconditional content of the outer and the inner, the being that exists in and for itself; unconditional with regard to the content-determinations insofar as it is not determined through an other, and with regard to form insofar as its externality is grounded in its own internality.
zh: 实体是外在与内在的无条件的内容，是自在自为存在的本质；就诸内容规定而言它是无条件的，因为它不是通过一个他者而得到规定的；就形式而言它是无条件的，因为它的外在性以它自己的内在性为根据。

en: All determined and conditioned existences are appearing determinations of substance and have a changeable and transient determinate being; they are accidents.
In their totality they constitute substance.
zh: 一切被规定且有条件的存在都是实体的显现着的规定，具有可变的、短暂易逝的定在；它们是偶性。
在其总体性上它们构成实体。

en: The accidents in their multiplicity present the content-determinations of substance in its essentiality in such a way that they traverse the circle of inessential circumstances, each of which is sublated in another, and only the simple substantial determination preserves itself.
Substance is the power of the accidents insofar as they sublate themselves in themselves, but at the same time in this sublation the substantial is revealed.
zh: 偶性以其杂多这样呈现实体的诸内容规定及其本质性：它们走过非本质情状的一个圆圈，其中每一种情状都在另一种情状中被扬弃，唯有那个简单的实体规定保存自身。
实体是偶性的威力，就偶性自在地扬弃自身而言；但正是在这种扬弃中，实体性的东西得到显现。

en: The accidents, insofar as they are contained in substance in themselves, are possible.
Substance is not possible but possibility itself.
zh: 偶性就它们自在地包含在实体之中而言，是可能的。
实体不是可能的，而是可能性本身。

en: Insofar as anything whatever is merely conceived in the form of being-in-itself, or as not contradicting itself, or is presented at all, it is called possible; it is a being-in-itself which is only posited, not in and for itself; a single determination has such a possibility separated from reality.
zh: 就某种东西只要被思为自在存在、或被思为与自身不矛盾、或总之只要被表象出来而言，它就被叫做可能的；它是一个仅仅被设定的自在存在，而不是自在自为的存在；单个的规定有一种与现实性相分离的这样的可能性。

en: Potentiation; the number sublates accidentality (its immediate, contingent being, which can equally be 4 or 5 and so on), and in this sublation, in altering, it manifests itself, it becomes power. — It is at first only contingent; an immediate; but square, cube is identical with itself, a having-become-in-itself.
It alters itself, but it is the determining of this its alteration; self-determination, reflectedness in itself. actu and potentia.
Difference between power and possibility; — I do not like.
zh: 自我产生；数扬弃了偶性（它那直接的、偶然的存在，这存在同样可以是 4 或 5 等等），而正是在这种扬弃中、在改变中，它显现出来，它成为威力。——它起初只是偶然的；一个直接者；但平方、立方是与自身同一的，是一种「已在自身中成为」的东西。
它改变自身，但它却是它这一改变的规定者；自我规定，对自身的反思。actu 与 potentia。
威力与可能性的差别；——我不喜欢。

en: Something is truly possible only as the totality of its determinations existing in itself; what has this inner, complete possibility is not merely something posited but is in and for itself and immediately actual.
The possibility of substance is therefore its actuality. {(God, for example, is not only possible as such but truly possible.
His possibility is a necessary one.
He is absolutely actual.)}
zh: 某物只有作为其自在地存在的诸规定的总体性才是真正可能的；具有这种内在的、完整的可能性之物，不仅仅是某个被设定的东西，而是自在自为地并且直接地现实。
所以实体的可能性就是它的现实性。{（例如上帝不只是笼统地可能，而是真正可能。
他的可能性是一种必然的可能性。
他是绝对现实的。）}

en: Reality is the reflectedness in itself; as actual — both a reflectedness in itself; possibility the form of being-in-itself; negative reflectedness; the sublation of the form of undeterminedness.
zh: 现实性就是那在自身中的反思；作为现实者——两者都是在自身中的反思；可能性是自在存在的形式，是否定性的反思；是不确定性形式的扬弃。

en: The connection of the accidents in substance is its necessity. {It is the unity of possibility and actuality.}

Necessity is blind insofar as the connection is merely inner, or insofar as the actual is not at the same time already present beforehand as the being-in-itself unity of its determinations, as purpose, but first results from their relation.
zh: 偶性在实体中的联系就是它的必然性。{它就是可能性与现实性的统一。}
必然性是盲的，就这种联系仅仅是内在的而言，或者就现实者并非同时已经预先作为其诸规定的自在存在统一、作为目的而存在，而只是从诸规定彼此的关系中才产生出来而言。

en: God is the absolute Idea of reason, not a being posited, not a imagining, not merely something possible; he is the necessary Idea; not posited through a foreign thinking.

God's knowledge is immediate and mediated, 1. as the knowledge of reason of its absolute, 2. mediated — the ascent from the finite, which is something merely contingent, possible; something merely posited, reflected in another; its reflection in itself is its reality.

It is not from the possibility of God as the ground, the truly first, — or the positive; — this possibility is the contingent world, which sublates itself in itself, reflects itself into itself out of its reflection-in-another, and is actual and manifests actuality.
zh: 上帝是理性的绝对观念，不是某个被设定的东西、不是某种设想之物、不只是某种可能之物；他是必然的观念；不是由一种外在的思维所设定的。
对上帝的认识既是直接的又是间接的：1. 作为理性对其绝对者的知识，2. 作为间接的——从有限者的上升，有限者是某种纯粹偶然的、可能的东西，是某个纯粹被设定的东西、在另一个之中被反思着的东西；它对自身的反思就是它的现实性。
现实性不是来自作为根据、真正第一者的上帝的可能性——或者说来自肯定者——这种可能性就是偶然的世界，它在自身中扬弃自身、从它对他者的反思中把自己反思到自身之中，并且是现实的、且显现出现实性。
